test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which letter-cluster will replace the question mark (?) to complete the given series?

PORK, NQPM, LSNO, JULQ, ?
solution:
According to the English alphabets and their positional values:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7d12502c2ca7d9724c6b72807e815218baf7d8f4c343b106b5314067691645b.png] 

The pattern followed in the given series is:

**The alphabet at odd places are decreased by 2 positional values.**

The alphabet at even places are increased by 2 positional values.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/391aefad179bc40c9d7c23baaa3f96f920341f308abd3bde06a73000ccd8c860.png] 

Hence **the correct answer is option 3).**
